mentions.name: Andurel
mentions.description: A fullstack web framework for Go that aims to provide a developer experience similar to Rails while preserving Go idioms. It is currently in beta and being prepared for a v1 release.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working in getting my fullstack web framework Andurel to v1 (currently in beta).

The goal is to approach the developer experience you get from Rails, but in Go, while keep as many of the idioms from Go.
